_comment: No composite indexes: every query the site makes is a single-collection read with no compound where/orderBy, which Firestore serves from the automatic single-field indexes. The fieldOverride below matters — the pack is stored as ~250,000-character string slices, and Firestore would otherwise build an index entry for each one. Nothing queries or orders by that field, so indexing it is pure storage and write cost, and very long values can trip index-entry size limits.
